baseline_definitions.verification_gate: VERIFIED + detected + confidence>=0.9 -> AUTO_REMEDIATE; else detected -> HUMAN_REVIEW; else MONITOR_ONLY. With template reasoning every alert is VERIFIED at 1.0, so this auto-remediates everything (strawman).
baseline_definitions.random: Python random.Random(seed), one draw per held-out alert
baseline_definitions.best_constant: Action with the best mean reward on the fold's training alerts (AUTO safety mask per alert)
baseline_definitions.supervised: Logistic regression P(attack) on the 6 non-constant context features (training folds), action with the best expected reward under the table, AUTO safety mask
baseline_definitions.score_tier: Up to 3 normalized-score tiers, cut points from training quantiles 0.05..0.95, each tier's best training action; pair with the best training mean (AUTO safety mask)

split: 5-fold over detected alerts only; each alert evaluated once on a policy that did not train on it

not_routed.note: Flows below the detector threshold never become alerts. They are detector misses or true negatives, not response decisions, and are excluded from policy scoring.

approval_simulator_assumption: CONFIRM_TO_ACT is assumed approved offline so its reward can be observed; this is not live approval.
